stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Rejection Handling
stories.description: Implement strict allowlist enforcement that blocks any tool not explicitly registered, returning a controlled rejection response without executing unintended logic.

stories.title: Structured Error Handling and Validation Feedback
stories.description: Standardize error responses for schema validation failures, missing fields, and malformed tool_use inputs, ensuring consistent messaging back into the agent loop.

stories.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
stories.description: Add structured logging for tool routing decisions, including selected tool, validation outcomes, execution timing, and failures to support debugging and auditability.
